newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CZECHS AMONG 6 STATES CHOSEN FOR EU EXPANSION TALKS.
newsitem.headline: CZECHS AMONG 6 STATES CHOSEN FOR EU EXPANSION TALKS.

text.p: The European Copmmission agreed in principle on Thursday to recommend the European Union open entry talks with Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Slovenia, Estonia and Cyprus, a senior Commission official told Reuters.
"The decision is for five plus one," the official said, referring to the jargon used to mean the five front-running east European candidates and Cyprus.
The information was confirmed by a second Commission official.

The final decision will be taken in Strasbourg, France, next Tuesday, a day before the EU executive officially unveils its recommendations to EU governments on which of the 10 east European applicants it should start talks with.

Thursday's decision followed a day-long meeting at the Commission aimed at resolving differences between Commissioners who wanted the first enlargement wave limited to Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary and Cyprus and those who favoured adding Slovenia and Estonia.
